extensionDescription.message: Preserve your privacy and strengthen your security in one click.

siteExclusionsReloadRequired.message: Reload FuzeVPN from the browser’s extension manager to finish the update and use site exclusions.

extensionCommunicationError.message: The extension is not responding. Close this window, then reload FuzeVPN from the browser’s extension manager.

loginSubtitle.message: Sign in to protect your browsing in this browser.

browserOnlyNotice.message: This browser only. Other apps and browsers are not covered.

incognitoHelp.message: Private browsing uses the same protection only when the extension is allowed in private mode in the browser’s settings.

confirmDeleteDevice.message: Remove “$1”? Its VPN connections will stop and its profiles will be removed.

confirmResetDevice.message: Reset this extension? It will be registered as a new device the next time you use it.

error_invalid_credentials.message: The email address or password is incorrect.

error_unauthorized.message: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

error_email_verification_required.message: Verify your email address before enabling protection.

errorVerificationCooldown.message: A new email can be requested in $1 seconds.

error_verification_email_cooldown.message: Please wait before requesting another email.

error_subscription_required.message: An active subscription is required to protect this browser.

error_device_limit.message: Device limit reached. Please remove a device.

error_device_identity_revoked.message: This device is no longer authorized. Try connecting again.

error_device_proof_invalid.message: We could not verify this device. Check your computer’s date and time, then retry.

error_device_proof_replayed.message: This request has already been processed. Try again.

error_invalid_device.message: This device was not recognized. Try connecting again.

error_device_exists.message: This device identity is already linked to another account.

error_not_found.message: This operation is no longer available. Try again.

error_invalid_location.message: This location is unavailable. Choose another one.

error_rate_limited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

error_proxy_unavailable.message: This server is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

error_api_token_expired.message: Your account session has expired. Please sign in again.

error_network_error.message: The network is unavailable. Check your Internet connection.

error_request_timeout.message: The service took too long to respond. Try again.

error_invalid_response.message: The service returned an unexpected response.

error_proxy_certificate_invalid.message: We could not verify the server’s security. The connection has been stopped.

error_proxy_controlled_by_extension.message: Another extension currently controls the browser’s proxy.

error_proxy_controlled_by_policy.message: An administrator policy prevents FuzeVPN from changing the proxy.

error_proxy_authentication_failed.message: The server did not accept the connection. Try connecting again.

error_session_expired.message: Your protected connection has expired. Connect again.

error_email_delivery_unavailable.message: The email cannot be sent right now.

error_unknown_error.message: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

recoveryHelp.message: Retry to resume protection. Disconnect lets you browse without FuzeVPN.

killSwitchHelp.message: Blocks new web requests if the VPN connection drops. Excluded sites remain accessible outside the VPN.

webRtcHelp.message: Helps keep your IP address private during web calls. Some calls may not work. Turning this off may reveal your real IP address.

localNetworkHelp.message: Local IP addresses and common local names are blocked during protection. An excluded domain may still provide access to the local network. System IPv6 settings are unchanged.

killSwitchLimits.message: This browser only: existing connections and some internal browser or other extension communications may continue. Another extension or a policy may replace the proxy before FuzeVPN reacts. Disabling the extension removes protection. No system-wide blocking.

error_traffic_guard_failed.message: The browsing block could not be verified. Protection is not guaranteed. Check the extension permissions.

error_webrtc_control_unavailable.message: The WebRTC restriction could not be applied. Check your settings, other extensions or administrator policy.

languageHelp.message: Changes apply immediately. Automatic follows the browser’s language, which may differ from the system language.

languageSaveError.message: Could not save the language. Your previous choice is kept. Try again.

ipLookupExplanation.message: IP checked with ipify using your current connection. No browsing history is sent.

automaticLocationHelp.message: Best recent response time, or your last location.

noFavoriteLocations.message: Add a star to keep your favorite locations here.

noRecentLocations.message: Your recently connected locations will appear here.

locationSaveError.message: The change could not be completed. Some settings may have been saved. Check the displayed choice before trying again.

siteExclusionsHelp.message: These sites use your connection without FuzeVPN, even if the VPN goes down.

siteExclusionsEmpty.message: No excluded sites. Add only sites you want to use without the VPN.

siteExclusionsResources.message: Resources from other domains stay protected. Excluding a page does not automatically exclude its other content.

siteExclusionsReload.message: Reload the site after a change. Existing connections may keep their previous route.

siteExclusionsWebRtc.message: WebRTC protection remains a global setting, including for excluded sites.

siteExclusionsLocal.message: Saved only in this browser and kept after signing out of your account.

siteExclusionsInterrupted.message: Change interrupted. The temporary guard remains in place.

siteExclusionsSaveError.message: Could not finish the change. Check your settings and try again.

siteExclusionInvalid.message: Enter a valid public domain. IPs, local names, wildcards, public suffixes and reserved domains are not accepted.

siteExclusionDuplicate.message: This domain is already on the list.

siteExclusionsLimit.message: The 100-site limit has been reached. Remove a site to add another.

logoutUnconfirmedHelp.message: Some remote sessions may remain active until they expire.

error_proxy_creation_uncertain.message: The server did not confirm creation of the new connection. Automatic reconnection is paused.

siteExclusionsPreferencesReset.message: Your saved site exceptions were reset after they could not be read. Add the sites you want to exclude again.

siteExclusionsConflict.message: The excluded sites list has changed. Review it, then try your change again.

verificationSent.message: Verification email sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

error_login_requires_disconnect.message: Disconnect the current VPN connection before signing in to another account.

error_storage_unavailable.message: Local account settings are unavailable. Retry when browser storage is available; your saved account has been preserved.

diagnosticsIntro.message: Check FuzeVPN and the current connection without changing your protection.

diagnosticsPrivacy.message: Reports contain technical states and error codes, never passwords, tokens, email addresses, IP addresses, visited URLs or excluded domains.

diagnosticsAutoHelp.message: Off by default. Only simple technical reports are sent for this account, without browsing history. Support keeps them for 30 days.

diagnosticsHistoryHelp.message: Technical history stays local: up to 200 events over 10 minutes, even when automatic sending is off. It contains no browsing history and is cleared when the browser closes or the account changes.

diagnosticsAccountRequired.message: Sign in to enable sending. You can still view and export a report without an account.

diagnosticsRetention.message: Sent reports are linked to your signed-in account and kept by support for 30 days. Deleting a local report does not delete a report already received by support.

diagnosticsDataCollectionRequired.message: Firefox must allow technical data collection to send diagnostics. Try again and grant this permission.

diagnosticsSendHelp.message: Sending is optional. Once approved, it may retry for up to 24 hours with a valid session for the same account. You can cancel further attempts. Cancelling late does not guarantee that the server has not already received the report.

diagnosticsUnavailable.message: Diagnostics are unavailable. Reload FuzeVPN from the browser’s extension manager, then reopen this page. Your VPN is unchanged.

diagnosticsQueueFull.message: The sending queue is full. Delete a local report or wait for a pending report to finish.

diagnosticsContentUnavailable.message: The report content is unavailable. Export the local report if it is available and contact support.

diagnosticsFailure.message: The diagnostic action could not be completed. Your VPN is unchanged.

diagnosticsStatus_session_required.message: Waiting for a valid session for the same account

error_private_browsing_required.message: Firefox requires this permission to configure the VPN, even in normal windows. Open about:addons → FuzeVPN, allow it to run in private windows, then retry.

error_host_permissions_required.message: In Firefox, open about:addons → FuzeVPN → Permissions and allow access to all websites, then retry.

locationsRefreshError.message: The location list could not be refreshed. Please try again.

error_device_revoked_limit.message: This device has been revoked. Device limit reached: please remove a device.

noAvailableLocations.message: No locations are currently available. Please try again shortly.

noAvailableFavoriteLocations.message: Your favorite locations are temporarily unavailable.

error_server_full.message: This server is full. Choose another location.

error_capacity_unavailable.message: This server’s availability cannot be confirmed right now. Please try again shortly.

locationHierarchyHelp.message: The name selects a server; the arrow shows details.

webSignInHelp.message: Sign in or create an account with Google or email in the FuzeVPN client area.

webSignInDisconnectHelp.message: This button stops browser protection so you can sign in with Google or email. Your browsing will be unprotected during sign-in.

webSignInStatus.message: Continue in the FuzeVPN sign-in window. The extension updates automatically when you finish. Close that window to cancel.

error_web_login_timeout.message: Sign-in took too long. Try again.

error_web_login_unavailable.message: Web sign-in is unavailable. Try again later.

error_web_login_invalid_callback.message: Sign-in could not be verified. Start again from the extension.

error_web_login_denied.message: Sign-in was not authorized. Try again.

error_web_login_busy.message: Close the sign-in window already open before trying again.
